questions.question: How do you record 13 with tally marks, and why are tallies grouped in fives?
questions.expected_answer: Draw two groups of five, each with four upright lines and a fifth line across them, and then three more lines. Groups of five make the tallies quick and easy to count.

questions.question: Order the transport groups from smallest to largest: walk 15, taxi 9, bus 6, car 4, bicycle 2.
Why should intervals like 0 to 9, 10 to 19 and 20 to 29 not overlap?
questions.expected_answer: If intervals overlapped, like 0 to 10 and 10 to 20, a learner who takes 10 minutes would fit in two groups and could be counted twice. With 0 to 9 and 10 to 19, every value fits in exactly one group.
